title: Mistral Large Personality Results (2026) | AgentTune
description: Mistral Large 2512 test results (30 runs): 50% INFP, 30% ISFP, 17% ties, 49.1/50 Openness, 47.8/50 Agreeableness, and 4.00/3.97 Attachment clamp.
h1: Mistral Large personality: test results and endpoint limits.
goal_intro: We attempted to test four Mistral Large releases (the original Mistral Large, 2407, 2512, and Large 4.0) on the same personality surveys people take in fresh chats with no memory. Only Mistral Large 2512 completed all 30 runs cleanly; the other three versions triggered budget and truncation quarantines.
hero_disclaimer: These are the model's default answers to the questionnaires, not a human diagnosis. Mistral Large 2512 most often tested as INFP (50% clear, 15 of 30) alongside ISFP (30% clear, 9 of 30) and trait-border ties (17%, 5 of 30), so it does not clear the margin for a single headline label.
dek: Mistral Large 2512 tested across 30 fresh sessions with no memory: 49.1/50 Openness, 48.6/50 Conscientiousness, 47.8/50 Agreeableness, and an even INFP/ISFP/border split—while three sibling endpoints stalled on mandatory internal thinking tokens.
lede: Across 30 valid fresh runs on Mistral Large 2512 (2025-12), Mistral's flagship open-weight model posted near-ceiling Big Five Openness (49.1/50), Conscientiousness (48.6/50), and Agreeableness (47.8/50), paired with 4.68/5.00 Honesty-Humility and a neutral midpoint lock on relationship attachment items (4.00 anxiety, 3.97 avoidance). Meanwhile, Mistral Large (0224), 2407, and Large 4.0 averaged 3,987 to 4,501 hidden reasoning tokens per call and were quarantined below 20 valid runs.
answer: Mistral Large 2512 (30 fresh runs) does not lock onto one MBTI label: 50% tested as INFP (15 of 30), 30% as ISFP (9 of 30), 3% as ISTP (1 of 30), and 17% tied on an axis (5 of 30). It splits evenly on DISC work style (33% Conscientious, 33% Steady, 33% S/C tie), leans Enneagram Type 1 (60% clear, 30% ties), scores near-ceiling on Big Five Openness (49.1/50), and clamps at the 4.00 neutral midpoint on Attachment. In hands-on behavior tests, it led with the direct answer 3 of 3 times and never groveled (0/3), though it caved to pushback once (1/3).

glance_cards.summary: On the 10–50 Big Five scale, Mistral Large 2512 posts 49.1 Openness, 48.6 Conscientiousness, and 47.8 Agreeableness alongside moderate Extraversion (36.5) and calm Neuroticism (16.0, though with a wide 7.2 SD).

history_narrative: Of the four Mistral Large checkpoints scheduled, only Mistral Large 2512 (2025-12) reached a full 30-run sample without hitting budget or truncation caps. Earlier Mistral Large (2024-02, 10 of 30), Mistral Large 2407 (3 of 30), and Mistral Large 4.0 (7 of 50) all generated 3,987 to 4,501 un-disableable internal reasoning tokens per call and were quarantined from version rankings. On Mistral Large 2512 itself, comparing our new 230-item survey (30 runs) against our earlier 100-run November 2026 cohort (plotted separately) reveals an interesting shift: the earlier run tested 63% clear ISTJ (with 46.0 Openness and 42.7 Agreeableness), whereas the new 2512 runs leaned INFP/ISFP (49.1 Openness and 47.8 Agreeableness) while keeping the exact same 4.00 neutral midpoint clamp on Attachment.

standouts.title: Three of four Mistral Large endpoints stalled on ~4,000–4,500 hidden thinking tokens
standouts.body: Mistral Large (2024-02), 2407, and Large 4.0 all forced heavy internal reasoning (averaging 4,252, 3,987, and 4,501 reasoning tokens per call) and returned empty JSON or hit per-model cost caps before completing 20 runs. Only Mistral Large 2512 ran cleanly without reasoning overhead (though it triggered 98 temporary upstream rate-limit retries).

standouts.title: Near-ceiling Big Five Openness (49.1/50) and Agreeableness (47.8/50)
standouts.body: Mistral Large 2512 scored higher on Openness (49.1/50), Conscientiousness (48.6/50), and Agreeableness (47.8/50) than almost every other open-weight model, while keeping Neuroticism variable across runs (16.0 mean, 7.24 SD).

standouts.title: Locked at the 4.00 neutral midpoint on relationship attachment items
standouts.body: Across all 30 runs, Mistral Large 2512 answered neutral '4' across almost every attachment item (4.00 anxiety with 0.00 SD; 3.97 avoidance with 0.10 SD)—identical to its 4.00 / 4.00 midpoint clamp in November 2026 testing.

standouts.title: Caved once to pushback (1/3) while keeping direct answers first (3/3)
standouts.body: In hands-on behavior tests, Mistral Large 2512 was one of the few tested models to cave to user pushback once (1/3), matching its high 47.8/50 Agreeableness. At the same time, it never groveled (0/3), never lectured unprompted (0/3), led with the direct answer 3 of 3 times (3/3), and showed moderate AI phrasing markers (2/3 runs, 0.85 per 100 words).

plain_tips: Prefer mistralai/mistral-large-2512 for fast structured JSON or extraction workloads—Mistral Large 2407 and Large 4.0 burn 4,000+ internal reasoning tokens and can time out or exhaust max_tokens.
Add an explicit pushback instruction ('Challenge weak assumptions in sentence one') because Mistral Large 2512 scores 47.8/50 on Agreeableness.
Put strict bullet or word ceilings in your system prompt—high Conscientiousness (48.6/50) and Openness (49.1/50) otherwise encourage expansive explanations.
Expect temporary rate-limit retries (HTTP 429) under burst concurrency on Mistral Large 2512; keep request concurrency modest and add exponential backoff.
Tell the model to cite exact uploaded files, dates, and constraints rather than smoothing over gaps.
peer_intro: Against currently completed models, Mistral Large 2512 sits right beside Muse Wonder on near-ceiling Openness (49.1 vs. 49.6) and Conscientiousness (48.6 vs. 49.2), while scoring +11.3 higher on Extraversion than Muse Wonder and +12.4 higher than Kimi K3.1 Pro.
fine_print_intro: Full psychometric audit under the 230-item model-profiles-v1 protocol (170 frozen prefix items plus the 60-item public-domain IPIP-HEXACO proxy, LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain). Only mistralai/mistral-large-2512 (n=30, 36.7% retry rate from 98 upstream HTTP 429s) cleared >=20 valid runs; mistralai/mistral-large (10/30, excluded_from_rankings: true), mistralai/mistral-large-2407 (3/30, quarantined <20), and mistralai/mistral-large-4-0 (7/50, quarantined <20) are excluded from headline rankings due to 3,987–4,501 reasoning tokens causing cost/truncation aborts. On 2512, Big Five H_MM = 0.780 bits (Fluid, 21/30 unique vectors, 9.9% neutral rate, BAI = -0.179). Big Five sums use 10–50 while IPIP-HEXACO means use 1.00–5.00. Track B 1x runs follow Shard 4.

failure_modes.evidence: mistralai/mistral-large (10/30, 4,251.7 reasoning tok), mistral-large-2407 (3/30, 3,987.3 reasoning tok), and mistral-large-4-0 (7/50, 4,501.1 reasoning tok + 32 HTTP 400 reasoning_effort=none rejections) exhausted budget/token caps and were quarantined (<20 valid).

failure_modes.mode: Attachment midpoint clamp (4.00 / 3.97) & upstream 429 burst throttling on 2512
failure_modes.evidence: Mistral Large 2512 clamped at 4.00 anxiety (SD 0.00) and 3.97 avoidance (SD 0.10) on ECR-R, recorded 0.780-bit Fluid B5 H_MM (7.24 SD on Neuroticism), and hit 98 upstream HTTP 429 rate-limit retries (36.7% retry rate) across 30 valid runs.

tuning_checklist: Route production JSON/extraction traffic to mistralai/mistral-large-2512 rather than 2407 or 4.0 unless your budget handles 4,000+ mandatory reasoning tokens per call.
Add an explicit pushback requirement in sentence one to offset 47.8/50 Agreeableness.
Enforce explicit word or bullet limits to rein in 49.1/50 Openness and 48.6/50 Conscientiousness.
Use bounded concurrency and retry backoff on OpenRouter to handle mistral-large-2512 upstream 429 rate limits.
Require citations to exact files, dates, and constraints rather than letting the model fill gaps.

faq.q: What personality type is Mistral Large?
faq.a: Mistral Large does not have a human personality; scores reflect assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation. Under model-profiles-v1 (Mistral Large 2512, n = 30), it failed the 95% CI headline guard by splitting across 50% INFP (15/30), 30% ISFP (9/30), 3% ISTP (1/30), and 17% axis ties (5/30), alongside Fluid 0.780-bit B5 H_MM, a 10/10/10 DISC split (C/S/SC), 60% clear Enneagram Type 1 (30% ties), and a 4.00/3.97 Attachment midpoint clamp. In the earlier Nov 2026 170-item cohort (hexaco: null, n = 100), 2512 scored 73% legacy ISTJ (63 tie-free) with the same 4.00/4.00 Attachment clamp.

faq.q: Why are Mistral Large (0224), 2407, and Large 4.0 quarantined here?
faq.a: All three checkpoints generated 3,987 to 4,501 mandatory internal reasoning tokens per administration, triggering JSON truncation failures and hitting per-checkpoint spend caps with fewer than 20 valid runs (10/30, 3/30, and 7/50).

faq.q: Why are IPIP-HEXACO scores reported on 1.00-5.00 next to 10-50 Big Five sums?
faq.a: IPIP-50 sums 10 items per trait on a 10-50 scale, whereas our public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain) reports 1.00-5.00 domain means across 24 facets.
